caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a woman standing and facing forward on a plain, light beige background. She is dressed in a long, full skirt and a matching dark greenish-grey cloak or shawl that wraps around her shoulders and is fastened in front, with a bit of a lighter, perhaps light lavender or grey scarf tucked at her neck. She has a dark bonnet or hood covering her hair, which is parted in the middle with dark strands visible on her forehead. Her hands are visible hanging at her sides. The woman’s face is shaded with soft tones, with defined red cheeks and lips contrasting her pale skin. The drawing is composed using mostly muted colors with the exception of the face, and the background is unadorned and blank.
title: Doll
